proposals.evidence: The whole walking response is short-vowel cal- walk + gone. Turner calati supplies the cal- stem and gata the suppletive gay-/gy- perfect auxiliary. Ordinary stem/past vowels are preserved; the whole response is represented by two ordered constituents.
